name: io.github.norve-labs/irl-gateway
title: IRL Gateway
description: An AI agent's trading mandate it can't break: checked before every order, reasoning sealed in IRL.

environmentVariables.name: IRL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: IRL server URL. Optional: by default read from ~/.irl-gateway/agent.json; run `uvx irl-gateway init` to create it (free paper token from https://norve.dev)

environmentVariables.name: IRL_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the IRL server. Optional: by default read from ~/.irl-gateway/agent.json, or run `uvx irl-gateway init`

environmentVariables.name: IRL_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The agent registered on IRL (its mandate). Optional: by default read from ~/.irl-gateway/agent.json, or run `uvx irl-gateway init`

environmentVariables.name: IRL_MODEL_HASH
environmentVariables.description: The model hash the agent was registered with (64 hex). Optional: by default read from ~/.irl-gateway/agent.json, or run `uvx irl-gateway init`

environmentVariables.name: GATEWAY_BROKER
environmentVariables.description: paper (default, live prices, no keys) or exchange
